statement: A square prism, base 40 mm side and height 65 mm, has its base on the H.P. and its vertical faces equally inclined to the V.P. Draw its projections.

placement.restingCondition: Base resting on HP, vertical faces equally inclined at 45° to VP

notes: Simple position. Width across corners is 40 * sqrt(2) = 56.5685 mm in both front and top views.
